text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 10-11 पर ‘The King and the Spider’ पढ़ो। पहले बताओ कि कहानी में क्या पहले हुआ।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 10-11 par ‘The King and the Spider’ padho. Pehle batao ki kahani mein kya pehle hua.
text.en: Read ‘The King and the Spider’ on pages 10–11 of your book. First, tell what happened first in the story.

steps.question: Which comes first in the story?

questionMeaning.hi: कहानी में सबसे पहले क्या आता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kahani mein sabse pehle kya aata hai?

options: The King was wise, brave and kind.
The King was sad and worried.
Many of his soldiers were killed.
steps.answer: The King was wise, brave and kind.

steps.question: What comes just after ‘People were very happy in his kingdom’?

questionMeaning.hi: ‘लोग राज्य में ख़ुश थे’ के ठीक बाद क्या आता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: ‘Log raajya mein khush the’ ke theek baad kya aata hai?

options: Once a neighbouring King attacked his country.
The King was sad and worried.
The King was wise, brave and kind.
steps.answer: Once a neighbouring King attacked his country.

steps.question: Which comes last of these?

questionMeaning.hi: इनमें से आख़िर में क्या आता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Inmein se aakhir mein kya aata hai?

options: The King was sad and worried.
Many of his soldiers were killed.
Once a neighbouring King attacked his country.
steps.answer: The King was sad and worried.

text.hi: सही क्रम: 3. The King was wise, brave and kind. 5. People were very happy in his kingdom. 4. Once a neighbouring King attacked his country. 2. Many of his soldiers were killed. 1. The King was sad and worried.
text.hinglish: Sahi kram: 3. The King was wise, brave and kind. 5. People were very happy in his kingdom. 4. Once a neighbouring King attacked his country. 2. Many of his soldiers were killed. 1. The King was sad and worried.
text.en: The right order: 3. The King was wise, brave and kind. 5. People were very happy in his kingdom. 4. Once a neighbouring King attacked his country. 2. Many of his soldiers were killed. 1. The King was sad and worried.

steps.question: What kind of ruler was the King?
options: wise, brave and kind
cruel and lazy
weak and afraid
steps.modelAnswer: The King was a wise, brave and kind ruler.

modelMeaning.hi: राजा समझदार, बहादुर और दयालु शासक था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Raja samajhdaar, bahaadur aur dayaalu shaasak tha.

steps.question: Who attacked his country?

questionMeaning.hi: उसके देश पर किसने हमला किया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Uske desh par kisne hamla kiya?

options: a neighbouring king
a spider
his own soldiers
steps.modelAnswer: A neighbouring king attacked his country.

modelMeaning.hi: एक पड़ोसी राजा ने उसके देश पर हमला किया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Ek padosi raja ne uske desh par hamla kiya.

steps.question: What happened to the King and his soldiers in the battle?

questionMeaning.hi: लड़ाई में राजा और सैनिकों का क्या हुआ?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Ladaai mein raja aur sainikon ka kya hua?

options: He lost; many soldiers were killed and others ran away.
They won easily.
They all went home happily.
steps.answer: He lost; many soldiers were killed and others ran away.
steps.modelAnswer: The King lost the battle. Many of his soldiers were killed and others ran away to save their lives. The King had to hide in a cave.

modelMeaning.hi: राजा लड़ाई हार गया। कई सैनिक मारे गए और बाकी जान बचाकर भाग गए। राजा को गुफ़ा में छिपना पड़ा।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Raja ladaai haar gaya. Kai sainik maare gaye aur baaki jaan bachaakar bhaag gaye. Raja ko gufaa mein chhipna pada.

steps.question: What did the King see in the cave?

questionMeaning.hi: राजा ने गुफ़ा में क्या देखा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Raja ne gufaa mein kya dekha?

options: a spider trying again and again to climb the wall
a lion sleeping
a box of gold
steps.answer: a spider trying again and again to climb the wall
steps.modelAnswer: In the cave, the King saw a spider trying again and again to climb the wall. At last it succeeded.

modelMeaning.hi: गुफ़ा में राजा ने एक मकड़ी को बार-बार दीवार पर चढ़ने की कोशिश करते देखा। आख़िर में वह सफल हुई।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Gufaa mein raja ne ek makdi ko baar-baar deewaar par chadhne ki koshish karte dekha. Aakhir mein woh safal hui.

steps.question: What did the King do after watching the spider?

questionMeaning.hi: मकड़ी को देखकर राजा ने क्या किया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Makdi ko dekhkar raja ne kya kiya?

options: He united his soldiers, attacked again and defeated his enemy.
He stayed in the cave forever.
He gave his kingdom away.
steps.answer: He united his soldiers, attacked again and defeated his enemy.
steps.modelAnswer: After watching the spider, the King got his confidence back. He united his soldiers, attacked his enemy and finally defeated him.

modelMeaning.hi: मकड़ी को देखकर राजा का आत्मविश्वास लौट आया। उसने सैनिकों को इकट्ठा किया, हमला किया और दुश्मन को हरा दिया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Makdi ko dekhkar raja ka aatmavishwaas laut aaya. Usne sainikon ko ikattha kiya, hamla kiya aur dushman ko hara diya.
